svg.title: Púca — a white-hat security kit that meets your systems on the road and tests them
svg.desc: The púca, a pixel shapeshifter from Irish folklore, stands on a night road and shifts into a hare, a goat and a black dog. Probes leave its feet for targets on the horizon; those inside the scope boundary light up, and the one outside it is stopped at the boundary in red: no scope, no fire.
svg.text: WHITE-HAT · OWASP-MAPPED · WEB · API · AGENTIC / MCP
Meets your systems on the road and tests them.
